content.text: The Post Office Horizon IT scandal had a 'disastrous' impact on those wrongly accused and prosecuted for criminal offences, the first report from the official inquiry into the scandal has found.

Ray Lonsdale, hailing from South Hetton in County Durham, holds the view that his 2010 sculpture, The Big Dance, located in Gretna Green, Scotland, has been copied by New Zealand sculptor James Wright.
Mark Gatiss dressed in gold and red robes addresses students graduating from Durham University at a ceremony at Durham Cathedral.
